# OrgFlow user and admin guide

<!-- Generated by `python manage.py export_help_docs` from core/help_content.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

The same guides appear in the app under **Help** in the sidebar, where each person sees the sections for their role.

## Member guides

_For everyone with an account._

### Sign up and apply to join

1. On the Sign in page, choose **Create an account and apply to join** (or **Get Started**). You can also sign in with Google.
2. Fill in your details and your application statement, then submit.
3. Until an officer approves you, you are an Applicant. On your dashboard, choose **View or submit an application** to see **My applications** and their status.
4. If an application is rejected, the reason is shown there. You can apply again after 1 day.

### RSVP to an event

1. Open **Events** and choose an upcoming event.
2. Under **Your RSVP**, choose **Going** or **Not going**.
3. You can change your answer until the event starts. Cancelled events don't take RSVPs.

### View your attendance

1. Open **My account** and scroll to **My attendance**.
2. You'll see each past event since your membership started, whether your attendance was recorded, and your attendance rate.

### Claim and update tasks

1. Open **Tasks**. Use **Filter tasks** to narrow by committee, status, priority or due date.
2. To take an unassigned task in one of your committees, open it and choose **Assign to me**.
3. To report progress on your task, open it, choose **Update progress**, pick a status (To Do, In Progress, Under Review or Done) and choose **Save status**.
4. The **Task history** on each task shows every change.

### See a committee's task board

1. Open **Committees** and choose a committee you're on. Officers and Admins can open any committee.
2. Under **Task board**, the **Workload** table shows each person's open and overdue tasks and their next due date, plus **Unassigned** work nobody has claimed yet.
3. **Open tasks by deadline** lists the committee's open tasks by due date, then priority. Late ones are marked **Overdue**. Choose a task to open it.

### Read announcements

1. Open **Announcements**. Search by keyword, or filter by category or tag (click a tag on any post to filter by it).
2. Open a post to read it, then choose **Mark as read**.
3. If comments are enabled, add yours and choose **Post comment**.
4. Committee announcements are only shown to that committee's members.

### Check your notifications

1. Choose **Notifications** in the sidebar. The number next to it is how many you haven't read.
2. You get a notification when an announcement is published for you (organization-wide, or for a committee you're on) and when a task is assigned to you.
3. Choose a notification to open the announcement or task. Opening it marks it as read.
4. Choose **Mark all as read** to clear the count.

### Download resources

1. Open **Resources**. Search, or filter by category or tag.
2. Choose **Download document** for a file or **Open link** for an external link.

### Find people in the roster

1. Open **Roster**.
2. Under **Name, email or username**, type a name, username or email and choose **Search**. Picking an **Organization role** or **Committee** filters the list straight away. Choose **Clear** to remove the filters.
3. Officers and Admins can also filter by **Status** (Active, Suspended, Pending approval or Disabled) and see a Status column.

### Edit your profile

1. Open **My account** and choose **Edit profile**.
2. Update your first and last name, contact email and graduation year, then choose **Save profile**.
3. If you sign in with Google, your email is managed by Google and can't be changed here.

### Reset your password

1. On the Sign in page, choose **Forgot your password?**.
2. Enter your email and choose **Send reset link**.
3. Open the link in the email (it expires after 3 days) and choose **Set password** with your new password.
4. Accounts that only use Google sign-in don't have a password; use **Sign in with Google**.

## Officer guides

_Shown to Officers and Admins._

### Review applications

1. Open **Applications** under Officer Tools. Search by name or email, or filter by status.
2. For each pending application, approve it, or reject it with a reason (a reason is required to reject).
3. If **Finish account access** appears on a reviewed application, choose it to complete the member's access update.

### Create events and record attendance

1. Open **Events** and choose **New event**. Enter the title, location, description, start time and an optional end time, then choose **Save event**.
2. To change or call off an event, open it and choose **Edit event** or **Cancel event**.
3. After the event, open it and go to **Attendance**. Check off the members who attended and choose **Save attendance**. Saving again replaces the list.

### Manage committees and tasks

1. Open **Committees** and choose **New committee**. Enter a name and description and confirm the Chair.
2. Open a committee to **Add a member**, change roles with **Save role**, or **Edit committee**. Only Admins can delete a committee.
3. Open **Tasks** and choose **New task**. Set the title, description, committee (or the whole organization), due date, priority and assignee, then choose **Save task**.
4. Committee Chairs can create, edit and assign tasks within the committees they chair.

### Review AI meeting drafts

1. Choose **Start Note Transcription** (or open **Notes**). Type your officer notes, and choose **Start Notes** to record the meeting with your microphone. Choose **Submit Notes** when you're done.
2. The AI writes a summary and proposed action items, saved as a draft that is **Pending review**. Only Officers and Admins can see drafts.
3. On the draft, edit an action item's text, untick **Keep** to drop it, or add new ones under **Add action items (one per line)**.
4. Choose a decision (**Approved**, **Revision requested** or **Rejected**) and choose **Submit review**. After a revision request, use **Revise notes and regenerate**.
5. For an approved draft, choose **Create tasks from accepted action items** and then **Confirm and create tasks**. Nothing becomes a task without an officer's approval.

> If the AI service is offline, your notes are still saved as a draft marked **Manual summary**. Write the summary on the draft page, add action items under **Add action items (one per line)**, and submit the review. A summary is required to approve it.
> To use a recording made elsewhere (phone, Zoom or Teams), choose **Upload a recording** on the Take notes page before **Submit Notes**. Use an mp3, m4a, wav, webm, ogg, flac or mp4 file up to 25 MB.

### Publish announcements and resources

1. Open **Announcements** and create an announcement. Add a title, category, **Audience** (all members, or a committee you belong to), tags and the body text.
2. Optionally set a **Scheduled Auto-Publish Time**, add attachments, a location or a meeting link, and allow comments.
3. Choose **Publish Announcement**, or **Save Draft** to finish later.
4. Open **Resources** and choose **Add resource**. Add a title, description, category and tags, then upload a file (up to 25 MB) or enter a link, and choose **Save resource**.

### View participation reports

1. Open **Reports** under Officer Tools. Pick a start and end date and choose **Generate report**.
2. The report shows each event's RSVPs and attendance, each member's attendance and tasks, and each committee's attendance and tasks. **How numbers are calculated** explains each figure.
3. Under **Download CSV**, choose a report (all reports as a ZIP, or one table) and choose **Download**.
4. Scroll down to **Charts** for attendance by event, attendance by committee and tasks by committee for the same dates. The tables above stay available if the charts can't load.

## Admin guides

_Shown to Admins only._

### Change roles

1. Open **Users** under Admin.
2. Find the person, choose their new role and choose **Save**. Every role change is recorded in the audit history.

### Approve officer applications

1. Members apply with **Apply to become an officer** on their dashboard.
2. Open **Applications** and set **Application type** to Officer. Officers can see these requests, but only Admins can decide them.
3. Approve to promote the member to Officer, or reject with a reason (a reason is required to reject). The member sees the decision under their officer applications.
4. If an approval is interrupted, choose **Finish approval** to complete it.

### Suspend and reinstate accounts

1. Open **Users** under Admin and choose **Suspend** or **Reinstate** for the account.
2. A suspended account can't sign in, and existing sessions stop working.
3. If **Finish suspension** or **Finish reinstatement** appears, choose it to complete the change.

### View audit history

1. Open **Audit history** under Admin.
2. Filter by type (role, membership, attendance or task changes) and by date, then choose **Apply filters**.

### Export the roster

1. Open **Roster**, search or filter as needed, and choose **Export CSV**.
2. The file lists each member's username, email, role, committees, join date and account status.

## Frequently asked questions

**I applied. Why can't I see events or the roster yet?**

Applicants only see the dashboard and the Apply page until an officer approves the application.

**How soon can I apply again after a rejection?**

After 1 day. The rejection reason is shown on the Apply page.

**Why can't I RSVP to an event?**

RSVPs close when the event starts, and cancelled events don't take RSVPs.

**Where does my attendance rate count from?**

From the date your membership was approved. Events before that aren't counted.

**Which tasks can I see?**

Tasks in the committees you belong to, and organization tasks assigned to you. Officers and Admins see all tasks.

**Who can see AI meeting drafts?**

Only Officers and Admins. A draft never becomes tasks or an announcement until an officer approves it.

**Why can't I change my email?**

Accounts that sign in with Google keep the Google email. Other accounts can change it under Edit profile.

**My password reset link doesn't work.**

Reset links expire after 3 days and work once. Request a new one from Forgot your password?.

**Who can delete a committee?**

Only Admins, and only after its tasks and committee announcements have been moved or cleared.
